name: Adjourned Agenda and Minutes
agenda_text:
AGENDA FOR THE
SAN DIEGO CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA FOR REGULAR COUNCIL MEETINGS
OF
MONDAY, DECEMBER 22, 2025
TUESDAY, DECEMBER 23, 2025
MONDAY, DECEMBER 29, 2025
TUESDAY, DECEMBER 30, 2025
CITY ADMINISTRATION BUILDING
COUNCIL CHAMBERS – 12 TH FLOOR
202 “C” STREET
SAN DIEGO, CA 92101
---------------------------
The City Council meetings of December 22 through December 30 of 2025 have been adjourned, pursuant to the 2025 Legislative Calendar adopted by Resolution 315876 on November 12, 2024, and amended by Resolution 316221 on May 20, 2025.
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the City Council is Monday, January 12, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., and Tuesday, January 13, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.
